findings.title: X-Workspace-Skipped-Count not exposed through CORS
findings.problem: The download-all route sets the custom X-Workspace-Skipped-Count header to signal a partial archive, but CORSMiddleware only lists Content-Disposition in expose_headers. A browser client on a different origin (WEBAPP_CORS is configured) cannot read the header.
findings.impact: A partial archive looks complete to the UI user; the header is the only machine-readable skip signal outside the zip manifest. Whether the web app is deployed cross-origin was not confirmed, so reachability is unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Add "X-Workspace-Skipped-Count" to expose_headers in the CORSMiddleware configuration, next to "Content-Disposition".
findings.resolution: resolved in dbf47d427; verified by the check round

findings.title: Archive logic bloats agent_workspace_service module
findings.problem: About 150 lines of archive code (WorkspaceArchive, error types, constants, _ArchiveProgress, _archive_filename, build/zip/audit/read-entry methods) are appended to a ~1200-line module whose core responsibility is workspace CRUD. code-quality.md Module Cohesion says to extract the new piece first when a file is 500+ lines and the change is not its core responsibility.
findings.impact: Documented blocking code-quality standard is violated; the module grows further past the size threshold.
findings.recommendation: Move the archive types, constants, _archive_filename and the build/zip/audit/read-entry logic into a new module next to the service (for example workspace_archive.py); have AgentWorkspaceService.build_workspace_archive delegate to it and update router and test imports.
findings.resolution: resolved in dbf47d427; verified by the check round
